summary: Destructor for an array of 198-dword objects, or a single such object, selected by flag bits in a2. Bit 2 selects the array path: reads the element count from the header dword at this-1, walks the array backward overwriting each vtable pointer with off_59E720 and calling MultiFieldCleanupDestructor on the sub-object at +53 dwords, then returns the header pointer. The single-object path applies the same vtable/sub-object cleanup to this itself. Bit 1 in a2 additionally frees the backing block via FreeWrapper_7bcf.

operations.description: Branch on flag bit 2 of a2: if (a2 & 2) != 0 take the array path, otherwise the single-object path.
Array path: read the element count v3 from the header dword at this-1 and set v4 to the header pointer (this-1).
Array path: compute v5 = this + 198*v3 (pointer one element past the last 198-dword element).
Array path: guard on (v3 - 1) >= 0; when the count is zero the walk is skipped entirely.
Array path: do-while loop walking the elements backward (v5 -= 198 dwords each iteration) for v3 iterations.
Array path, per element: overwrite the element vtable pointer (field this 0x0 relative to element base) with &off_59E720.
Array path, per element: call MultiFieldCleanupDestructor on the sub-object at element base + 53 dwords (0xD4).
Array path: guard on flag bit 1 of a2: if (a2 & 1) != 0 free the block.
Array path: call FreeWrapper_7bcf on the header pointer v4 (this-1) when the free flag is set.
Array path: return the header pointer v4 (this-1).
Single-object path: overwrite this's own vtable pointer (field this 0x0) with &off_59E720.
Single-object path: call MultiFieldCleanupDestructor on the sub-object at this + 53 dwords (0xD4).
Single-object path: guard on flag bit 1 of a2: if (a2 & 1) != 0 free the block.
Single-object path: call FreeWrapper_7bcf on this when the free flag is set.

unresolved: The element count header at this-1 is outside the packet's listed field evidence (only field this 0x0 is tracked).
Layout and ownership of the 53-dword sub-object destroyed by MultiFieldCleanupDestructor is unknown.
Meaning of the two flag bits in a2 (bit 2 = array/single mode, bit 1 = free) is inferred from control flow, not confirmed by an external contract.
Caller GraphicsResourceDestructor (0x0040FB30) usage that selects these flags is unexamined.
